def validate_clean_contact_payload(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, str, Dict[str, str]]:
    """
    Validates anti-bot honeypots, dwell timing, 12-bit SHA-256 Proof-of-Work,
    and strict anti-phishing / anti-spam rules for contact submissions.
    """
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return False, "Formato de solicitud inválido.", {}

    for hp_field in ("website_url", "company_fax", "bluetooth_magenta_argyle_rhino", "_gotcha"):
        hp_val = data.get(hp_field)
        if hp_val not in (None, "", False, 0, "0"):
            return False, "Validación de seguridad rechazada.", {}

    try:
        dwell_ms = int(data.get("dwell_ms", 0))
        ts_ms = int(data.get("ts_ms", 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False, "Metadatos de verificación inválidos.", {}

    if dwell_ms < 4500:
        return False, "Envío demasiado rápido detectado por protección anti-bot.", {}

    now_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
    if ts_ms < (now_ms - 3_600_000) or ts_ms > (now_ms + 300_000):
        return False, "Marca temporal de seguridad expirada. Recarga e intenta de nuevo.", {}

    name = str(data.get("name") or "").strip()
    email = str(data.get("email") or "").strip()
    phone = str(data.get("phone") or "").strip()
    company = str(data.get("company") or "").strip()
    codigo = str(data.get("codigo") or "").strip()
    message = str(data.get("message") or data.get("text") or data.get("notes") or "").strip()
    pow_nonce = str(data.get("pow_nonce") or "").strip()

    if not pow_nonce:
        return False, "Falta prueba criptográfica anti-bot SHA-256.", {}

    expected_challenge = f"JBZ-POW-V1|{email.lower()}|{ts_ms}|{pow_nonce}"
    pow_digest = hashlib.sha256(expected_challenge.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    if not pow_digest.startswith("000"):
        return False, "Prueba criptográfica SHA-256 inválida.", {}

    for fld_label, fld_val in (
        ("nombre", name),
        ("correo", email),
        ("teléfono", phone),
        ("empresa", company),
        ("código", codigo),
        ("mensaje", message),
    ):
        if _CONTACT_URL_RX.search(fld_val):
            return False, f"Por ciberseguridad no se permiten enlaces externos ni HTML en el campo {fld_label}.", {}
        if _CYRILLIC_SPAM_RX.search(fld_val):
            return False, "Contenido bloqueado por filtro de spam.", {}

    if not (3 <= len(name) <= 120) or re.search(r"\d", name):
        return False, "Ingresa un nombre y apellido válido (sin números ni enlaces).", {}

    if not _EMAIL_STRICT_RX.match(email):
        return False, "Formato de correo electrónico inválido.", {}
    domain_part = email.rsplit("@", 1)[1].lower()
    if domain_part in _DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS:
        return False, "No se admiten correos temporales o desechables.", {}

    if not _PHONE_ALLOWED_RX.match(phone):
        return False, "Formato de teléfono inválido.", {}
    digits_only = re.sub(r"\D", "", phone)
    if not (7 <= len(digits_only) <= 16):
        return False, "El número telefónico debe contener entre 7 y 16 dígitos.", {}

    if not (20 <= len(message) <= 2000):
        return False, "El mensaje debe tener entre 20 y 2,000 caracteres.", {}
    words = [w for w in message.split() if len(w) >= 1]
    if len(words) < 4:
        return False, "Describe brevemente tu consulta en al menos 4 palabras.", {}

    alpha_chars = [ch for ch in message if ch.isalpha()]
    if len(alpha_chars) >= 10:
        vowel_count = sum(1 for ch in alpha_chars if ch in "aeiouáéíóúüAEIOUÁÉÍÓÚÜ")
        if (vowel_count / len(alpha_chars)) < 0.18:
            return False, "El texto ingresado no parece un mensaje legible válido.", {}

    msg_lower = message.lower()
    for kw in _PHISHING_KEYWORDS:
        if kw in msg_lower:
            return False, "Mensaje bloqueado por filtro anti-phishing.", {}

    clean_payload = {
        "name": name,
        "email": email,
        "phone": phone,
        "company": company[:140],
        "codigo": codigo[:80],
        "message": message,
        "source": str(data.get("source") or "jesusbz.github.io")[:80],
        "verified_sha256_pow": pow_digest[:16],
        "received_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
    }
    return True, "OK", clean_payload


class _SlidingWindowRateLimiter:
    """Thread-safe per-IP sliding-window rate limiter."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._buckets: Dict[str, deque] = defaultdict(deque)

    def allow(self, key: str, max_hits: int, window_sec: float) -> bool:
        now = time.monotonic()
        cutoff = now - window_sec
        with self._lock:
            dq = self._buckets[key]
            while dq and dq[0] < cutoff:
                dq.popleft()
            if len(dq) >= max_hits:
                return False
            dq.append(now)
            if len(self._buckets) > 4096:
                stale = [k for k, v in self._buckets.items() if not v]
                for k in stale[:512]:
                    del self._buckets[k]
            return True


class SuiteHTTPServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True

    def finish_request(self, request, client_address) -> None:
        try:

        except OSError:
            pass
        super().finish_request(request, client_address)


def start_suite_http_server(
    base_dir: pathlib.Path,
    host: str = "0.0.0.0",
    port: int = 10000,
    vault_config: Optional[VaultRuntimeConfig] = None,
) -> ThreadingHTTPServer:
    """Inicia servidor HTTP hardened con gzip, rate-limiting, firewall /api/contact y CORS estricto."""
    boot_monotonic = time.monotonic()
    payload_cache_lock = threading.Lock()
    payload_cache: Dict[str, Tuple[int, bytes, bytes]] = {}
    rate_limiter = _SlidingWindowRateLimiter()
    static_vault = vault_config

    def _get_vault() -> VaultRuntimeConfig:
        return static_vault if static_vault is not None else load_vault_config()

    def _is_trusted_origin(origin_val: str, cfg: VaultRuntimeConfig) -> bool:
        norm = origin_val.strip().rstrip("/")
        if not norm:
            return False
        if norm in cfg.allowed_origins:
            return True
        if re.match(r"^http://(?:127\.0\.0\.1|localhost)(?::\d{1,5})?$", norm, re.IGNORECASE):
            return True
        return False

    def _cached_file_bytes(path_obj: pathlib.Path) -> Tuple[bytes, bytes]:
        if not path_obj.exists():
            raw = b"{}"
            return raw, gzip.compress(raw, compresslevel=6)
        cache_key = str(path_obj)
        for _ in range(2):
            try:
                st_res = path_obj.stat()
                mtime_ns = st_res.st_mtime_ns
                with payload_cache_lock:
                    cached = payload_cache.get(cache_key)
                    if cached and cached[0] == mtime_ns:
                        return cached[1], cached[2]
                raw = path_obj.read_bytes()
                gz = gzip.compress(raw, compresslevel=6)
                with payload_cache_lock:
                    payload_cache[cache_key] = (mtime_ns, raw, gz)
                return raw, gz
            except OSError:
                time.sleep(0.05)
        raw = b"{}"
        return raw, gzip.compress(raw, compresslevel=6)

    class SuiteRequestHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
            return

        def _client_ip(self) -> str:
            x_fwd = self.headers.get("X-Forwarded-For", "")
            if x_fwd:
                first_hop = x_fwd.split(",")[0].strip()
                if first_hop:
                    return first_hop[:64]
            return self.client_address[0] if self.client_address else "unknown"

        def _resolve_cors_origin(self, require_origin: bool) -> Optional[str]:
            cfg = _get_vault()
            raw_origin = (self.headers.get("Origin") or "").strip()
            if raw_origin:
                if _is_trusted_origin(raw_origin, cfg):
                    return raw_origin.rstrip("/")
                return None
            if require_origin:
                return None
            return "https://jesusbz.github.io"

        def _send_security_headers(self, cors_origin: Optional[str], vary_encoding: bool = False) -> None:
            self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
            self.send_header("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
            self.send_header("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
            self.send_header("Permissions-Policy", "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=()")
            self.send_header("Strict-Transport-Security", "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains")
            self.send_header("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0")
            if cors_origin:
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", cors_origin)
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, HEAD, POST, OPTIONS")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Accept")
            self.send_header("Vary", "Accept-Encoding, Origin" if vary_encoding else "Origin")

        def _send_json_response(
            self,
            status_code: int,
            raw_body: bytes,
            cors_origin: Optional[str],
            send_body: bool = True,
            gz_body: Optional[bytes] = None,
        ) -> None:
            accept_enc = (self.headers.get("Accept-Encoding") or "").lower()
            use_gzip = gz_body is not None and "gzip" in accept_enc
            out_bytes = gz_body if use_gzip else raw_body
            self.send_response(status_code)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            if use_gzip:
                self.send_header("Content-Encoding", "gzip")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(out_bytes)))
            self._send_security_headers(cors_origin, vary_encoding=(gz_body is not None))
            self.end_headers()
            if send_body:
                self.wfile.write(out_bytes)

        def do_OPTIONS(self) -> None:
            clean_path = urlsplit(self.path).path.rstrip("/") or "/"
            cors_origin = self._resolve_cors_origin(require_origin=(clean_path == "/api/contact"))
            if cors_origin is None:
                self._send_json_response(403, b'{"status":"forbidden_origin"}', None, send_body=True)
                return
            self.send_response(204)
            self._send_security_headers(cors_origin)
            self.end_headers()

        def _handle_req(self, send_body: bool) -> None:
            clean_path = urlsplit(self.path).path.rstrip("/") or "/"
            cors_origin = self._resolve_cors_origin(require_origin=False)
            if cors_origin is None:
                self._send_json_response(403, b'{"status":"forbidden_origin"}', None, send_body=send_body)
                return

            client_ip = self._client_ip()
            if clean_path in ("/", "/health", "/api/health"):
                if not rate_limiter.allow(f"health:{client_ip}", max_hits=240, window_sec=60.0):
                    self._send_json_response(429, b'{"status":"rate_limited"}', cors_origin, send_body=send_body)
                    return
                cfg = _get_vault()
                ledger_path = base_dir / "bot_state_ledger.json"
                st: Dict[str, Any] = {}
                if ledger_path.exists():
                    try:
                        st = json.loads(ledger_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                    except Exception:
                        st = {}
                last_sync = str(st.get("last_sync_utc") or st.get("last_updated_utc") or "")
                payload = {
                    "status": "ok",
                    "service": "jbz-quant-crypto-multibot",
                    "bots_active": 4,
                    "utc_now": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
                    "uptime_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - boot_monotonic, 1),
                    "execution_mode": cfg.execution_mode,
                    "plan_profile": "render-24x7",
                    "execution_cycles": int(st.get("execution_cycles", 0)),
                    "last_sync_utc": last_sync,
                    "last_updated_utc": last_sync,
                    "chain_root_sha256": str(st.get("chain_root_sha256", "")),
                    "total_certified_orders": int(st.get("total_certified_orders", 0)),
                }
                body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
                self._send_json_response(200, body, cors_origin, send_body=send_body)
                return

            if clean_path in ("/quant_crypto_suite.json", "/api/suite"):
                if not rate_limiter.allow(f"data:{client_ip}", max_hits=90, window_sec=60.0):
                    self._send_json_response(429, b'{"status":"rate_limited"}', cors_origin, send_body=send_body)
                    return
                raw, gz = _cached_file_bytes(base_dir / "quant_crypto_suite.json")
                self._send_json_response(200, raw, cors_origin, send_body=send_body, gz_body=(gz if send_body else None))
                return

            if clean_path == "/history.json":
                if not rate_limiter.allow(f"data:{client_ip}", max_hits=90, window_sec=60.0):
                    self._send_json_response(429, b'{"status":"rate_limited"}', cors_origin, send_body=send_body)
                    return
                raw, gz = _cached_file_bytes(base_dir / "history.json")
                self._send_json_response(200, raw, cors_origin, send_body=send_body, gz_body=(gz if send_body else None))
                return

            self._send_json_response(404, b'{"status":"not_found"}', cors_origin, send_body=send_body)

        def do_GET(self) -> None:
            self._handle_req(send_body=True)

        def do_HEAD(self) -> None:
            self._handle_req(send_body=False)

        def do_POST(self) -> None:
            clean_path = urlsplit(self.path).path.rstrip("/") or "/"
            if clean_path != "/api/contact":
                cors_origin = self._resolve_cors_origin(require_origin=False)
                self._send_json_response(404, b'{"status":"not_found"}', cors_origin, send_body=True)
                return

            cors_origin = self._resolve_cors_origin(require_origin=True)
            if cors_origin is None:
                self._send_json_response(403, b'{"status":"forbidden_origin"}', None, send_body=True)
                return

            client_ip = self._client_ip()
            if not rate_limiter.allow(f"contact_burst:{client_ip}", max_hits=20, window_sec=60.0):
                self._send_json_response(429, b'{"status":"rate_limited","error":"Demasiados intentos en poco tiempo."}', cors_origin, send_body=True)
                return

            try:
                content_len = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
            except ValueError:
                self._send_json_response(400, b'{"status":"invalid_length"}', cors_origin, send_body=True)
                return

            if content_len <= 0 or content_len > 16384:
                status_c = 413 if content_len > 16384 else 400
                self._send_json_response(status_c, b'{"status":"invalid_payload_size"}', cors_origin, send_body=True)
                return

            raw_bytes = self.rfile.read(content_len)
            if len(raw_bytes) != content_len or len(raw_bytes) > 16384:
                self._send_json_response(413, b'{"status":"payload_too_large"}', cors_origin, send_body=True)
                return

            try:
                body_data = json.loads(raw_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
            except Exception:
                self._send_json_response(400, b'{"status":"invalid_json"}', cors_origin, send_body=True)
                return

            ok, reason, clean_payload = validate_clean_contact_payload(body_data)
            if not ok:
                err_b = json.dumps({"status": "rejected", "error": reason}, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
                self._send_json_response(400, err_b, cors_origin, send_body=True)
                return

            if not rate_limiter.allow(f"contact_valid:{client_ip}", max_hits=3, window_sec=3600.0):
                self._send_json_response(429, b'{"status":"rate_limited","error":"Limite de envios por hora alcanzado."}', cors_origin, send_body=True)
                return

            cfg = _get_vault()
            if not cfg.inbound_form_endpoint.is_configured():
                self._send_json_response(503, b'{"status":"relay_unconfigured"}', cors_origin, send_body=True)
                return

            endpoint_url = cfg.inbound_form_endpoint.get_secret_value()
            parsed_ep = urlsplit(endpoint_url)
            ep_host = (parsed_ep.hostname or "").lower()
            if parsed_ep.scheme.lower() != "https" or not ep_host or ep_host in ("localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"):
                self._send_json_response(503, b'{"status":"relay_unconfigured"}', cors_origin, send_body=True)
                return

            try:
                ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
                ssl_ctx.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
                fwd_bytes = json.dumps(clean_payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
                req = urllib.request.Request(
                    endpoint_url,
                    data=fwd_bytes,
                    headers={
                        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                        "Accept": "application/json",
                        "User-Agent": "JBZ-Contact-Firewall/1.0",
                    },
                    method="POST",
                )

                        self._send_json_response(200, ok_body, cors_origin, send_body=True)
                        return
                self._send_json_response(502, b'{"status":"upstream_error"}', cors_origin, send_body=True)
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.warning("Fallo al reenviar contacto validado: %s", scrub_secrets(str(exc)))
                self._send_json_response(502, b'{"status":"upstream_error"}', cors_origin, send_body=True)

    httpd = SuiteHTTPServer((host, int(port)), SuiteRequestHandler)
    srv_thread = threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    srv_thread.start()
    logger.info("Servidor HTTP hardened (/health, /api/suite, /api/contact) activo en %s:%d", httpd.server_address[0], httpd.server_address[1])
    return httpd


def main():

    parser.add_argument("--serve-web", action="store_true", help="Expone endpoint HTTP /health, /api/suite y /api/contact con CORS estricto para Render.")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=int(os.environ.get("PORT", "10000")), help="Puerto HTTP para modo servicio web.")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    vault_cfg = load_vault_config()
    base_dir = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    httpd: Optional[ThreadingHTTPServer] = None
    if args.serve_web or (args.daemon_intraday and os.environ.get("PORT")):
        httpd = start_suite_http_server(base_dir, host="0.0.0.0", port=args.port, vault_config=vault_cfg)

    stop_event = threading.Event()

    def _handle_shutdown(signum: int, _frame: Any) -> None:
        logger.info("Señal de apagado controlada recibida (%s). Cerrando servidor y guardando estado...", signum)
        stop_event.set()
        if httpd is not None:
            threading.Thread(target=httpd.shutdown, daemon=True).start()

    for sig_name in ("SIGTERM", "SIGINT"):
        sig_obj = getattr(signal, sig_name, None)
        if sig_obj is not None:
            try:
                signal.signal(sig_obj, _handle_shutdown)
            except ValueError:
                pass

    coins = list(SETTINGS.basket_coins)
    base_cap = SETTINGS.base_capital_usd
    oracle = MultiExchangeCryptoOracle(
        okx_base=SETTINGS.okx_base,
        bybit_base=SETTINGS.bybit_base,
        kucoin_base=SETTINGS.kucoin_base,
    )

    cached_daily = run_cycle(base_dir, oracle, coins, base_cap, cached_daily=None, vault_config=vault_cfg)
    if args.daemon_intraday:
        interval_sec = max(30, int(args.interval))
        logger.info("Modo servicio de ejecución continua activo (%s): sincronización intradía cada %ds.", vault_cfg.execution_mode.upper(), interval_sec)
        while not stop_event.is_set():
            if stop_event.wait(interval_sec):
                break
            try:
                cached_daily = run_cycle(base_dir, oracle, coins, base_cap, cached_daily=cached_daily, vault_config=vault_cfg)
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.warning("Aviso en ciclo intradía (reintento en %ds): %s", interval_sec, scrub_secrets(str(exc)))

    if httpd is not None and stop_event.is_set():
        httpd.server_close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def _sample_ohlcv(n: int = 80, drift: float = 0.002, seed: int = 42) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    rets = drift + rng.normal(0.0, 0.008, size=n)
    close = 100.0 * np.cumprod(1.0 + rets)
    high = close * (1.0 + rng.uniform(0.002, 0.010, size=n))
    low = close * (1.0 - rng.uniform(0.002, 0.010, size=n))
    open_p = np.roll(close, 1)
    open_p[0] = close[0] * 0.998
    high = np.maximum(high, np.maximum(open_p, close))
    low = np.minimum(low, np.minimum(open_p, close))
    vol = rng.uniform(1000.0, 2500.0, size=n)
    idx = pd.date_range("2026-11-10 00:00", periods=n, freq="15min")
    return pd.DataFrame({"open": open_p, "high": high, "low": low, "close": close, "volume": vol}, index=idx)

        df = _sample_ohlcv(90)

        stoch = calc_stoch_k(df, 14, 3)

    def test_10_bot_d_causal_mlp_no_lookahead_leakage(self):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
        X_train = rng.normal(0.0, 1.0, size=(120, 10))
        yr_train = 0.01 * X_train[:, 0] + rng.normal(0.0, 0.005, size=120)
        yc_train = (yr_train > 0.0).astype(int)
        scaler, reg, clf = fit_causal_mlp_ensemble(X_train, yr_train, yc_train, seed=101)

        x_live = np.array([[0.05, 0.02, 0.12, 0.06, 0.03, 0.04, 0.02, 0.15, 0.10, 0.25]])
        x_future_perturbed = np.vstack([x_live, rng.normal(5.0, 2.0, size=(5, 10))])
        p1 = float(clf.predict_proba(scaler.transform(x_live))[0, 1])
        r1 = float(reg.predict(scaler.transform(x_live))[0])
        p2 = float(clf.predict_proba(scaler.transform(x_future_perturbed))[0, 1])
        r2 = float(reg.predict(scaler.transform(x_future_perturbed))[0])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(p1, p2, places=10)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(r1, r2, places=10)

    def test_13_sha256_chain_integrity_and_tamper_detection(self):
        orders = [
            {
                "bot_id": "bot_a", "time_utc": "2026-11-22 10:00 UTC",

        ]
        signed, root = sign_orders_sha256_chain(orders, GENESIS_HASH)

        self.assertTrue(ok, msg=f"Errores inesperados: {errs}")

        self.assertFalse(ok_bad)
        self.assertTrue(len(bad_errs) >= 1)

    def test_14_generated_suite_json_contracts_and_sha256(self):
        json_path = BOT_DIR / "quant_crypto_suite.json"
        self.assertTrue(json_path.exists())

        def _reject_nan(token: str):
            raise AssertionError(f"Token JSON inválido: {token}")

        suite = json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), parse_constant=_reject_nan)
        self.assertEqual(suite["meta"]["base_capital_usd"], 1000.0)
        self.assertIn("python_source_modules", suite)

        # Identidad contable MTM exacta en los 4 algoritmos
        for bk, bot in suite["algo_bots"].items():
            self.assertEqual(bot["stats"]["base_usd"], 1000.0)
            self.assertTrue(bot.get("inception_utc"))
            if not bot["is_futures"]:
                pos_val = sum(p["units"] * p["market_price"] for p in bot["active_positions"] if p["coin"] != "USDT")
                drift = abs((bot["cash_usd"] + pos_val) - bot["stats"]["final_usd"])
            else:
                unreal = sum(p["units"] * (p["market_price"] - p["entry_price"]) for p in bot["active_positions"] if p["coin"] != "USDT")
                drift = abs((bot["cash_usd"] + unreal) - bot["stats"]["final_usd"])
            self.assertLess(drift, 0.05, msg=f"Desviación MTM en {bk}: {drift}")

        orders_chrono = list(reversed(suite["ledger_chain"]["orders"]))
        ok, vh, vb, errs = verify_orders_sha256_chain(
            orders_chrono, suite["ledger_chain"]["genesis_sha256"], suite["ledger_chain"]["chain_root_sha256"]
        )
        self.assertTrue(ok, msg=f"Fallo de verificación en JSON: {errs}")

    def test_20_contact_firewall_blocks_bots_urls_bad_pow_and_honeypots(self):
        from main import start_suite_http_server
        from src.execution.secure_vault import load_vault_config

        def _mine_pow(email: str, ts_ms: int) -> str:
            nonce = 0
            email_low = email.lower()
            while True:
                challenge = f"JBZ-POW-V1|{email_low}|{ts_ms}|{nonce}".encode("utf-8")
                if hashlib.sha256(challenge).hexdigest().startswith("000"):
                    return str(nonce)
                nonce += 1

        def _post_contact(port: int, payload: dict):
            req = urllib.request.Request(
                f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/api/contact",
                data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
                headers={
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "Origin": "https://jesusbz.github.io",
                },
                method="POST",
            )
            return urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)

        ts_now = int(time.time() * 1000)
        valid_email = "cliente.verificado@empresa.org"
        valid_pow = _mine_pow(valid_email, ts_now)
        base_human_payload = {
            "name": "Carlos Mendoza",
            "email": valid_email,
            "phone": "+58 412 5550199",
            "company": "Grupo Financiero Andino",
            "message": "Solicito consultoria cuantitativa en R y Python para modelado de riesgos financieros.",
            "ts_ms": ts_now,
            "dwell_ms": 6500,
            "pow_nonce": valid_pow,
            "website_url": "",
            "company_fax": "",
            "bluetooth_magenta_argyle_rhino": "",
        }

        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"INBOUND_FORM_ENDPOINT": ""}, clear=False):
            unconfigured_vault = load_vault_config()
        httpd = start_suite_http_server(BOT_DIR, host="127.0.0.1", port=0, vault_config=unconfigured_vault)
        actual_port = httpd.server_address[1]
        try:
            bad_cases = [
                {**base_human_payload, "website_url": "https://spam.bot"},
                {**base_human_payload, "dwell_ms": 800},
                {**base_human_payload, "pow_nonce": "badnonce"},
                {**base_human_payload, "message": "Hola revisa este link https://steal-data.xyz urgente por favor"},
                {
                    **base_human_payload,
                    "email": "hacker@mailinator.com",
                    "pow_nonce": _mine_pow("hacker@mailinator.com", ts_now),
                },
            ]
            for bad_payload in bad_cases:
                with self.assertRaises(urllib.error.HTTPError) as ctx_err:
                    _post_contact(actual_port, bad_payload)
                self.assertEqual(ctx_err.exception.code, 400)
                ctx_err.exception.close()

            with self.assertRaises(urllib.error.HTTPError) as ctx_unconf:
                _post_contact(actual_port, base_human_payload)
            self.assertEqual(ctx_unconf.exception.code, 503)
            ctx_unconf.exception.close()
        finally:
            httpd.shutdown()
            httpd.server_close()

        with patch.dict(
            os.environ,
            {"INBOUND_FORM_ENDPOINT": "https://secure-relay.invalid/hook/clean123"},
            clear=False,
        ):
            configured_vault = load_vault_config()
        httpd_ok = start_suite_http_server(BOT_DIR, host="127.0.0.1", port=0, vault_config=configured_vault)
        ok_port = httpd_ok.server_address[1]
        orig_urlopen = urllib.request.urlopen

        class _DummyUpstreamResponse:
            status = 200

            def __enter__(self):
                return self

            def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):
                return False

            def read(self):
                return b'{"ok":true}'

        def _selective_urlopen(req, *args, **kwargs):
            url = getattr(req, "full_url", str(req))
            if url.startswith("https://secure-relay.invalid/"):
                return _DummyUpstreamResponse()
            return orig_urlopen(req, *args, **kwargs)

        try:
            with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", side_effect=_selective_urlopen):
                with _post_contact(ok_port, base_human_payload) as resp_ok:
                    self.assertEqual(resp_ok.status, 200)
                    body_ok = json.loads(resp_ok.read().decode("utf-8"))

    def test_23_bot_d_mlp_early_stopping_zero_convergence_warnings(self):
        import warnings
        from sklearn.exceptions import ConvergenceWarning

        rng = np.random.default_rng(19)
        X_train = rng.normal(0.0, 1.0, size=(320, 10))
        yr_train = 0.008 * X_train[:, 0] - 0.004 * X_train[:, 2] + rng.normal(0.0, 0.006, size=320)
        yc_train = (yr_train > 0.002).astype(int)
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
            warnings.simplefilter("always", ConvergenceWarning)
            scaler, reg, clf = fit_causal_mlp_ensemble(X_train, yr_train, yc_train, seed=101)
        conv_warns = [w for w in caught if issubclass(w.category, ConvergenceWarning)]
        self.assertEqual(len(conv_warns), 0, msg=f"ConvergenceWarning inesperado: {conv_warns}")
        self.assertTrue(clf.early_stopping)
        self.assertTrue(reg.early_stopping)
        p = float(clf.predict_proba(scaler.transform(X_train[:1]))[0, 1])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(p, 0.0)
        self.assertLessEqual(p, 1.0)

    def test_26_triple_barrier_labeling_and_no_future_leakage(self) -> None:
        df_b = _sample_ohlcv(70, drift=0.004, seed=7)
        df_e = _sample_ohlcv(70, drift=-0.002, seed=9)
        close_df = pd.DataFrame({"BTC": df_b["close"], "ETH": df_e["close"]})
        high_df = pd.DataFrame({"BTC": df_b["high"], "ETH": df_e["high"]})
        low_df = pd.DataFrame({"BTC": df_b["low"], "ETH": df_e["low"]})
        atr_df = pd.DataFrame({
            "BTC": calc_atr(df_b, 14),
            "ETH": calc_atr(df_e, 14),
        })
        horizon = 4
        lbl1, ret1 = compute_triple_barrier_labels(
            close_df, high_df, low_df, atr_df,
            horizon=horizon, tp_atr_mult=1.80, sl_atr_mult=1.40, roundtrip_fee=0.0020,
        )
        self.assertTrue(lbl1.iloc[-horizon:].isna().all().all())
        valid_lbls = set(lbl1.iloc[:-horizon].stack().unique().tolist())
        self.assertTrue(valid_lbls.issubset({0.0, 1.0, 2.0}))
        self.assertFalse(ret1.iloc[:-horizon].isna().any().any())

        close_mod = close_df.copy()
        high_mod = high_df.copy()
        low_mod = low_df.copy()
        close_mod.iloc[50:] *= 1.35
        high_mod.iloc[50:] *= 1.40
        low_mod.iloc[50:] *= 0.85
        lbl2, ret2 = compute_triple_barrier_labels(
            close_mod, high_mod, low_mod, atr_df,
            horizon=horizon, tp_atr_mult=1.80, sl_atr_mult=1.40, roundtrip_fee=0.0020,
        )
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(lbl1.iloc[:44], lbl2.iloc[:44])
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(ret1.iloc[:44], ret2.iloc[:44])

    def test_27_gmm_four_market_regimes_classification(self) -> None:
        rng = np.random.default_rng(123)
        r_bull = np.full(60, 0.008) + rng.normal(0.0, 0.004, 60)
        r_flat = rng.normal(0.0, 0.002, 60)
        r_bear = np.full(60, -0.007) + rng.normal(0.0, 0.004, 60)
        r_hv = rng.normal(0.0, 0.055, 60)
        rets_btc = np.concatenate([r_bull, r_flat, r_bear, r_hv])
        idx = pd.date_range("2026-01-01", periods=len(rets_btc), freq="4h")
        c_btc = 100.0 * np.cumprod(1.0 + rets_btc)
        c_eth = 50.0 * np.cumprod(1.0 + 0.9 * rets_btc + rng.normal(0.0, 0.005, len(rets_btc)))
        c_sol = 20.0 * np.cumprod(1.0 + 1.1 * rets_btc + rng.normal(0.0, 0.006, len(rets_btc)))
        close_df = pd.DataFrame({"BTC": c_btc, "ETH": c_eth, "SOL": c_sol}, index=idx)
        adx_dict = {}
        for col in close_df.columns:
            s = close_df[col]
            oh = pd.DataFrame({"high": s * 1.006, "low": s * 0.994, "close": s}, index=idx)
            adx_dict[col] = calc_adx_di(oh, 14)[0]
        adx_df = pd.DataFrame(adx_dict, index=idx).bfill()

        res = detect_market_regimes_gmm(close_df, adx_df, btc_col="BTC", seed=42)
        cur = res["current_regime"]
        valid_codes = {"TENDENCIA_ALCISTA", "MERCADO_LATERAL", "TENDENCIA_BAJISTA", "ALTA_VOLATILIDAD"}
        self.assertIn(cur["code"], valid_codes)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(sum(cur["probabilities"].values()), 1.0, places=3)
        self.assertEqual(cur["code"], "ALTA_VOLATILIDAD")
        self.assertLessEqual(cur["risk_multiplier"], 0.55)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(cur["sl_atr_buffer"], 1.15)

    def test_28_supervised_3class_ensemble_purged_split_and_champion_challenger(self) -> None:
        import warnings
        from sklearn.exceptions import ConvergenceWarning

        n_bars = 260
        df_b = _sample_ohlcv(n_bars, drift=0.0025, seed=31)
        df_e = _sample_ohlcv(n_bars, drift=-0.001, seed=37)
        close_df = pd.DataFrame({"BTC": df_b["close"], "ETH": df_e["close"]})
        high_df = pd.DataFrame({"BTC": df_b["high"], "ETH": df_e["high"]})
        low_df = pd.DataFrame({"BTC": df_b["low"], "ETH": df_e["low"]})
        vol_df = pd.DataFrame({"BTC": df_b["volume"], "ETH": df_e["volume"]})
        vrel_df = vol_df / (vol_df.rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean() + 1e-9)
        atr_df = pd.DataFrame({"BTC": calc_atr(df_b, 14), "ETH": calc_atr(df_e, 14)})
        rsi_df = pd.DataFrame({c: calc_rsi(close_df[c], 14) for c in close_df.columns}).bfill()
        stoch_df = pd.DataFrame({"BTC": calc_stoch_k(df_b, 14, 3), "ETH": calc_stoch_k(df_e, 14, 3)}).bfill()
        ema9 = close_df.ewm(span=9, adjust=False).mean()
        ema21 = close_df.ewm(span=21, adjust=False).mean()
        ema55 = close_df.ewm(span=55, adjust=False).mean()
        roc12 = (close_df.pct_change(12) * 100.0).fillna(0.0)
        roc24 = (close_df.pct_change(24) * 100.0).fillna(0.0)
        macd_h = pd.DataFrame({c: compute_macd_pct(close_df[c])[2] for c in close_df.columns})
        bb_pb = pd.DataFrame({c: compute_bollinger(close_df[c], 20, 2.0)[3] for c in close_df.columns})
        bb_bw = pd.DataFrame({c: compute_bollinger(close_df[c], 20, 2.0)[4] for c in close_df.columns})
        obv_df = pd.DataFrame({c: calc_obv_slope(close_df[c], vol_df[c], 14) for c in close_df.columns})
        st = calc_structure_and_btc_metrics(close_df, high_df, low_df, "BTC", 20)
        lbl_df, ret_df = compute_triple_barrier_labels(close_df, high_df, low_df, atr_df, horizon=4)

        X_rows, yc_rows, yr_rows = [], [], []
        for ii in range(30, n_bars - 5):
            for c in ("BTC", "ETH"):
                if not np.isnan(lbl_df.iloc[ii][c]):
                    row = extract_ta_features_row(
                        ii, c, ema9, ema21, ema55, bb_pb, bb_bw, roc12, roc24, macd_h,
                        rsi_df, stoch_df, vrel_df,
                        obv_slope_df=obv_df, ema200_dist_df=st["ema200_dist"],
                        range_pos_df=st["range_pos"], btc_rel_df=st["btc_rel"], rsi_accel_df=st["rsi_accel"],
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(len(row), 15)
                    self.assertTrue(np.all(np.isfinite(row)))
                    X_rows.append(row)
                    yc_rows.append(int(lbl_df.iloc[ii][c]))
                    yr_rows.append(float(ret_df.iloc[ii][c]))

        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as rec_w:
            warnings.simplefilter("always", ConvergenceWarning)
            bundle = fit_supervised_3class_ensemble(np.asarray(X_rows), np.asarray(yc_rows), np.asarray(yr_rows), purge_samples=32, seed=101)
            conv_w = [w for w in rec_w if issubclass(w.category, ConvergenceWarning)]
            self.assertEqual(len(conv_w), 0)

        self.assertGreater(bundle["purged_gap"], 0)
        pred = predict_supervised_3class_ensemble(
            bundle, np.asarray(X_rows[-6:]),
            regime_probs={"TENDENCIA_ALCISTA": 0.55, "MERCADO_LATERAL": 0.25, "TENDENCIA_BAJISTA": 0.10, "ALTA_VOLATILIDAD": 0.10},
        )
        p_sums = pred["prob_bear"] + pred["prob_flat"] + pred["prob_bull"]
        for s_val in p_sums:
            self.assertAlmostEqual(float(s_val), 1.0, places=5)

        champ1, dec1 = govern_champion_challenger(None, bundle, "2026-11-24 04:00")
        self.assertTrue(dec1["promoted"])
        self.assertEqual(dec1["active_version"], 1)

        better = dict(champ1)
        better["oos_brier_score"] = max(0.01, float(champ1["oos_brier_score"]) - 0.02)
        better["oos_expectancy_pct"] = float(champ1["oos_expectancy_pct"]) + 0.10
        champ2, dec2 = govern_champion_challenger(champ1, better, "2026-11-24 08:00")
        self.assertTrue(dec2["promoted"])
        self.assertEqual(dec2["active_version"], 2)

        worse = dict(champ2)
        worse["oos_brier_score"] = 0.95
        worse["oos_expectancy_pct"] = -5.0
        champ3, dec3 = govern_champion_challenger(champ2, worse, "2026-11-24 12:00")
        self.assertFalse(dec3["promoted"])
        self.assertEqual(dec3["active_version"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(champ3["version"], 2)
